So, they scheme on how to access power. Look at Donald Trump. He has money but doesn't have power, which is why he ran for the presidency. Does it make sense? Remember that all these conflicts in the world are between upper nobility and low nobility—the haves and have-somes who want more. The poor don’t do anything; they just sit and die. Middle class people and rich people always want more, aspiring to be higher class. If the middle class wants more, the higher class won't allow it, suppressing them. This creates a French revolution. Any questions? Great.

So, remember this is about the Roman Empire—an empire based on hate where lives were terrible under its rule. There was massive slavery, debt, and corruption.
